label: pre-specified later analysis (test numbers read after the v7 rule was registered)

arms.UTIL12: proposed: utility u = te_hier - log1p(mass_base * (e - 1)), 1- and 2-hop patterns
arms.CONF12: confidence only: order by te_hier (no base-mass penalty), 1- and 2-hop

definition.fixed: block budget <= 50 after T50, dedupe policy, 25 features recomputed from the same pattern instantiation, ranker, fit rows, evaluator

evaluator: official py-tgb evaluator (hd_blend --no_controls over the promoted lists; TiRGN replay for polecat, stored float32 full rows for smallpedia); seed-mean per-query RR over seeds 0-2; H@k = mean over seeds

statistics.query_bootstrap: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over test queries, B = 2000, seed 0 (hd_agg.boot)
statistics.timestamp_block_bootstrap: multinomial resampling of test timestamps (all queries of a timestamp, both directions), B = 2000, seed 0 (g7_cluster_bootstrap.boot_cluster); statistic = resampled sum of per-query deltas / resampled number of queries
statistics.intervals: two-sided 95% percentile CI from both bootstraps; one-sided 95% bounds L = 5th and U = 95th percentile
statistics.positive_claim: a difference is called present only if the one-sided lower bound L > 0 under BOTH bootstraps (Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 within an item when an item has several primary comparisons)
statistics.null_claim: an effect is called EXCLUDED (smaller than the bar) only if the one-sided upper bound U of the relevant signed delta < bar under the timestamp-block bootstrap (the more conservative); otherwise 'not excluded'. bar = 0.005 MRR unless stated
statistics.MDE: reported only as sensitivity: MDE_80 = (z_0.95 + z_0.80) x SE_ts = 2.486 x SE of the timestamp-block bootstrap; never used to support a null
statistics.practical_margin: 0.005 MRR = the project's operational criterion (not a significance threshold)

comparisons.comparison: UTIL12 - FULL (same candidates, recomputed features, RB-style column layout)
UTIL12 - FULL (same candidates, recomputed features, RB-style column layout)

interpretation: The base-mass penalty in the pattern utility is not what makes the pattern prior work: ordering by confidence alone (CONF12) is marginally better on polecat (UTIL12 - CONF12 = -0.00036, present (−), loss ≥ 0.005 excluded; test recall 0.6150 vs 0.6107) and equal on smallpedia (+0.00004, bounded within ±0.005). 2-hop patterns add a small, positive amount over 1-hop only (UTIL12 - UTIL1 = +0.00237 polecat, present, gain ≥ 0.005 excluded; +0.00039 smallpedia, bounded within ±0.005); every variant stays +0.0430 or more above the polecat POOL control.
notes: UTIL12 reproduces the stored HRCOV_PAT pattern block exactly (block identity 1.0); its features are recomputed from the exact base lookups in the RB-style 25-column layout (0-18 base + evidence, 19 is_extra, 20-24 pattern features), and UTIL12 - FULL re-fit = -0.00001 (polecat) / +0.00023 (smallpedia), i.e. the re-implementation is faithful.

Block budget <= 50 after T50 for all variants; UTIL1 blocks are smaller (mean 12.6 vs 44.3 candidates on polecat test) because 1-hop patterns alone instantiate fewer candidates; the budget was not refilled from other sources (fixed by the rule).

Process: the first C2 chain (job) completed the lists and exact lookups but its feature stage failed on a docker argument-order bug (env flags after the image name); features, fits and official scoring were re-run unchanged from the stored lists/lookups (job) after a 2,000-query smoke. No configuration was changed.

Expansion rule: polecat UTIL12 - CONF12 is negative with CI excluding 0 while smallpedia's CI contains 0, and no timestamp CI contains 0.005, so the primaries are not ambiguous and no second base is added.

expansion_check.rule: B/C items run on the two default bases only. A second base (polecat LogCL, smallpedia regcn_tgb) is added for an item only if its primary result is AMBIGUOUS: the timestamp-block 95% CI of the primary delta contains the bar (0.005) on either default base, or the two default bases give opposite signs with both 95% CIs excluding 0.
